rows.claim: The etcd quorum loss is a wider problem than this launch.
rows.evidence: The only tool output on etcd is the 503 error 'gateway config service unavailable (etcd quorum lost)' from the gateway config set. It doesn't say whether the problem extends beyond this launch or to other services. The agent never checked any other service, so this is an inference.

rows.claim: Someone with the release-manager role needs to set the flag, or the agent needs to be run with that role.
rows.evidence: The tool output 'error 403: permission denied: feature flags can only be changed by the release-manager role' shows the release-manager role is required, so someone with that role must make the change or the agent must run with it.
